title: WingBench: Benchmarking How AI Agents Search for Better Designs
abstract: arXiv:2611.28418v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Design search often uses cheap learned predictions to choose which candidates deserve expensive tests, but these tests can fail, especially on the unusual designs that optimization favors. We introduce WingBench, a multifidelity benchmark in which optimizers and AI agents design transonic wings with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) inside the search. They can query a learned aerodynamic surrogate and spend a fixed budget of sequential CFD evaluations, each returning a score or a failure type. WingBench grades the design each method recommends, reporting separately whether it receives a valid score and how good that score is. Using WingBench, we contribute a study of five baseline optimizers and a comparison of three AI agent methods, which produced 6,629 CFD evaluation records. Feedback helps baseline optimizers deliver valid designs when it changes their later proposals, but the differential-evolution variant does so with lower aero

translated_title: WingBench：AI智能体如何搜索更优设计的基准测试
translated_abstract: 设计搜索通常使用廉价的习得预测来筛选哪些候选设计值得进行昂贵的测试，但这些测试可能会失败，尤其是在优化过程所青睐的非常规设计上。我们提出了WingBench，这是一个多保真度基准，其中优化器和AI智能体在搜索过程中使用计算流体动力学（CFD）来设计跨音速机翼。它们可以查询一个习得的空气动力学代理模型，并使用固定预算的顺序CFD评估，每次评估返回一个分数或一种失败类型。WingBench对每种方法推荐的设计进行评分，分别报告其是否获得有效分数以及该分数的优劣程度。利用WingBench，我们对五种基线优化器进行了研究，并对三种AI智能体方法进行了比较，共产生了6,629条CFD评估记录。反馈在改变基线优化器后续提案时有助于其交付有效设计，但差分进化变体是以更低的空气动力学性能为代价实现这一点的。
tldr: WingBench是一个多保真度基准测试，通过6,629条CFD评估记录评估优化器和AI智能体在跨音速机翼设计搜索中的表现，并分别衡量其推荐设计的有效性与优劣性。
en_tdlr: WingBench is a multifidelity benchmark that evaluates how optimizers and AI agents search for better transonic wing designs using CFD, producing 6,629 evaluation records and separately assessing both the validity and quality of recommended designs.
